item.tib: gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs las zhi ba don gyi sgrub pa rin chen spyi spungs
item.coloph: bka' ni stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis/ nam zhig dus la babs tsam na/ las dang bskal (skal) pa ldan pa la/ brgyud cing 'phel ba'i rgyu lags so/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i snyan du brgyud pa'o//
